# Lab 3.1: Create a Google Cloud Account & Free Trial

## What We Are Going to Do
Sign up for Google Cloud, activate the free trial credit, create a first project, and check that billing is linked.

## Steps

1. **Open the sign-up page.** Go to `https://cloud.google.com/free` and click **Get started for free**. Sign in with a Google account you will use only for this course.

2. **Fill in the trial form.** Choose your country, accept the terms, and add a payment method. The card is only for identity checks. You are not charged during the trial unless you choose to upgrade to a paid account.

3. **Open the console.** You land on `https://console.cloud.google.com`. A project named **My First Project** is created for you.

4. **Create a project for the labs.** Click the project picker at the top, then **New project**. Name it `pcse-labs`. Note the **Project ID** shown under the name, because every lab uses it.

5. **Check the trial credit.** Go to **Billing → Overview**. You see the free trial credit and the days left.

6. **Confirm billing is linked.** Go to **Billing → Account management** and check that `pcse-labs` is listed under the billing account.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Trial credit | Shown on the Billing overview page |
| Project ID | Unique worldwide and cannot be changed later |
| Charges | None during the trial unless you upgrade |
| Lab project | `pcse-labs` linked to the billing account |
